patch_description: Replace the placeholder (all points at origin, min area 0) with a deterministic multi-start local optimizer. Points are parametrized via softmax weights over the triangle's three vertices, which guarantees every point stays inside/on the triangle without constraints. The objective is a smooth soft-min surrogate of the 165 triangle areas (temperature annealed over a few stages), maximized with scipy's derivative-free Powell method from several fixed-seed starting configurations. The best result by true minimum-triangle-area is returned; a hardcoded symmetric fallback configuration guards against optimizer failure, ensuring the function always returns a feasible arrangement.
